pairs.question: Quid erilis noster filius?
pairs.derivation: Epidicus asks how the master's son is; Thesprio answers he is in fighting fitness. Single-line stichomythic exchange; no preamble to cut. Speaker labels EP./TH. and the inline verse number 20 stripped.

pairs.question: Vbi arma sunt Stratippocli?
pairs.derivation: Epidicus asks where Stratippocles' arms are; Thesprio answers they deserted to the enemy. Answer ends at first full stop; the following 'Armane?' is a fresh question. Speaker labels and inline number 30 stripped.

pairs.question: Cur eam emit?
pairs.derivation: Epidicus asks why Stratippocles bought the captive girl; Thesprio answers 'for love's sake'. Clean two-clause exchange; speaker labels EP./TH. and inline number 45 stripped.

pairs.question: Quid est, pater, quod me excivisti ante aedis?
pairs.answer: Vt matrem tuam videas, adeas, advenienti des salutem atque osculum.
pairs.derivation: Acropolistis asks why her supposed father called her out; Periphanes answers the purpose (to greet her mother). Answer is the complete purpose clause. Speaker labels ACR./PER., line-wrap, and inline number 570 stripped.

pairs.question: Quis istaec est quam tu osculum mihi ferre iubes?
pairs.derivation: Philippa asks who the girl is; Periphanes answers 'your daughter'. Clean one-line exchange; speaker labels PHIL./PER. stripped.

pairs.question: Cur me igitur patrem vocabas?
pairs.derivation: Periphanes asks Acropolistis why she called him father; she answers it is his fault, not hers. Answer ends at first full stop; the following 'non patrem ego te nominem...' is elaboration and is cut. Speaker labels stripped.

pairs.question: Quid, si ob eam rem hanc emisti, quia tuam gnatam es ratus, quibus de signis agnoscebas?
pairs.derivation: Philippa asks by what tokens Periphanes recognized the girl; he answers 'by none'. Editorial brackets in '<si>' stripped, keeping 'si'. Speaker labels PHIL./PER. and inline number stripped.

pairs.question: Qua re filiam credidisti nostram?
pairs.derivation: Philippa asks why he believed the girl their daughter; Periphanes answers the slave Epidicus told him. Clean exchange; speaker labels and inline number 598 stripped.

pairs.question: Non meministi me auream ad te afferre natali die lunulam atque anellum aureolum in digitum?
pairs.derivation: Epidicus asks Telestis whether she remembers the gifts he brought; she answers 'I remember, my man'. Answer ends at first full stop; the following 'tune is es?' is her own new question, cut. Speaker labels EP./TEL., line-wrap, and inline number 640 stripped.

pairs.question: Qua fiducia ausu's primum, quae emptast nudiustertius, filiam meam dicere esse?
pairs.derivation: Periphanes asks on what assurance Epidicus dared call the bought girl his daughter; Epidicus answers 'I felt like it: that assurance'. Self-contained reply. Speaker labels PER./EP. and inline number stripped.

pairs.question: Dedin tibi minas triginta ob filiam?
pairs.answer: Fateor datas et eo argento illam me emisse amicam fili fidicinam pro tua filia: is te eam ob rem tetigi triginta minis.
pairs.derivation: Periphanes asks (yes/no) whether he gave thirty minae for his daughter; Epidicus confirms and explains. Answer runs to the first full stop (the interior mark before 'is te...' is a colon, not a stop). Speaker labels and inline number 705 stripped.

pairs.question: Quid postremo argento factum est quod dedi?
pairs.answer: neque malo homini neque maligno tuo dedi Stratippocli.
pairs.derivation: Periphanes asks what finally became of the money he gave; Epidicus answers he gave it to Stratippocles. The reply's opening 'Dicam tibi:' is a non-answering announcement and is cut from the answer's start, advancing to the operative answering clause. Speaker labels and inline number 705 stripped.

pairs.question: Quor dare ausu's?
pairs.derivation: Periphanes asks why Epidicus dared give the money away; Epidicus answers 'because I felt like it'. Clean one-clause exchange; speaker labels and inline number 710 stripped.
